about: Shared weight-suggestion test vectors: bot/src/gymbot/services/next_weights.py (pytest bot/tests/test_next_weights.py) and miniapp/src/progression.ts + plan.ts (vitest). Shapes are the Mini App's (store.ts, program.ts). kind=suggest: suggestWeight, then the related-exercise transfer, then scaleWeight(factor). Dumbbell weights are per hand. source: override | history | baseline | related | hint | none. reasonContains is checked by pytest only (Mini App reasons may differ).
